# spirl_delegated_admin (Data Source)

Retrieves a delegated admin of a realm in SPIRL. Exactly one of `user_email`, `service_account_name`, or `idp_group` must be specified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve a delegated admin of a realm by user email
data "spirl_delegated_admin" "by_user" {
  trust_domain_id = spirl_trust_domain.my_domain.id
  realm_name      = "production"
  user_email      = "admin@example.com"
}

# Retrieve a delegated admin of a realm by service account name
data "spirl_delegated_admin" "by_service_account" {
  trust_domain_id      = spirl_trust_domain.my_domain.id
  realm_name           = "production"
  service_account_name = "ci-bot"
}

# Retrieve a delegated admin of a realm by IdP group name
data "spirl_delegated_admin" "by_idp_group" {
  trust_domain_id = spirl_trust_domain.my_domain.id
  realm_name      = "production"
  idp_group       = "platform-team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm_name` (String) The name of the realm
- `trust_domain_id` (String) The ID of the trust domain the realm belongs to

### Optional

- `idp_group` (String) The name of the delegated admin IdP group (mutually exclusive with user_email and service_account_name). Must exactly match the group name on the role assignment, including casing and whitespace.
- `service_account_name` (String) The name of the delegated admin service account (mutually exclusive with user_email and idp_group)
- `user_email` (String) The email of the delegated admin user (mutually exclusive with service_account_name and idp_group)

### Read-Only

- `assignment_id` (String) The ID of the realm role assignment that grants delegated admin
- `created_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the delegated admin assignment was created
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the delegated admin assignment (same as assignment_id)
